uq_inventory_grns_manufacturer_invoice_s.name: uq_inventory_grns_manufacturer_invoice_submitted
uq_inventory_grns_manufacturer_invoice_s.where: "inventory"."grns"."status" = 'submitted' and "inventory"."grns"."grn_type" = 'purchase' and "inventory"."grns"."manufacturer_id" is not null and length(btrim("inventory"."grns"."voucher_invoice_no")) > 0

indent_lines_approved_le_requested_chk.name: indent_lines_approved_le_requested_chk
indent_lines_approved_le_requested_chk.value: approved_qty is null or approved_qty <= requested_qty

indents_distinct_stores_chk.name: indents_distinct_stores_chk
indents_distinct_stores_chk.value: to_store_id is null or from_store_id <> to_store_id

items_classification_formulary_chk.name: items_classification_formulary_chk
items_classification_formulary_chk.value: (item_classification = 'medicine' and tenant_formulary_id is not null) or (item_classification = 'inventory' and tenant_formulary_id is null)

items_category_pair_chk.name: items_category_pair_chk
items_category_pair_chk.value: sub_category_id is null or category_id is not null
